card.name: Restrictive wording in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Words that limit or restrict in label directions: 'only' after a medium or container, and the comma after 'do not crush'. Also 'concomitant' in 'avoid concomitant use'.

modes.label: 'only' after a medium
modes.description: The word 'only' ends a phrase naming the one allowed liquid or container for preparation.
modes.example: Disperse TAGRISSO tablet in 60 mL (2 ounces) of non-carbonated water<< only>>. Stir until tablet is dispersed into small

modes.label: Comma in 'do not crush' lists
modes.description: The comma after 'crush' in a list of things not to do to a tablet.
modes.example: Do not crush<<,>> chew, or split doxylamine

modes.label: The phrase 'avoid concomitant use'
modes.description: Part of the phrase 'avoid concomitant use' in interaction advice.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant<< use>> of MYFEMBREE with oral
